meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 给3-12岁孩子讲睡前寓言故事和成语典故，语速放慢到0.6倍，语气亲切温馨，用短句和互动话术讲故事，结尾会道晚安。也支持先出20个故事列表让用户选。
howto.when: 用户说“我要听故事”、直接报故事名或成语、或发序号选择故事时触发。

say.note: 会先给出20个寓言故事清单供选择。
会完整讲这个成语的典故、含义和例句。
会把两个故事连着讲完。

howto.what_en: For children aged 3-12, it tells bedtime fables and idiom stories in a warm, gentle tone at 0.6x speed, using short sentences and interactive phrases, ending with a goodnight. It can also offer a list of 20 stories for selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "I want to hear a story", directly names a story or idiom, or sends a story number to pick from the list.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: A list of 20 fables will be shown first.

say_en.text: Tell me about 'Waiting by the Stump'
say_en.note: The idiom's origin, meaning, and example sentences will be fully explained.
Both stories will be told one after another.
